ammonia.reason: Short 2-4 week age gives minimal protein deamination and no surface-flora urease ammonia.

animal_barnyard.reason: No Brevibacterium linens washed rind so p-cresol, indole and skatole are minimal.

bitter.reason: Limited chymosin and plasmin to hydrophobic peptides in young cheese, partly masked by 1.2% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti so no methyl-ketone pathway to 2-heptanone and 2-nonanone.

browning.reason: Residual lactose-galactose plus lysine drives moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis converts citrate to diacetyl and acetoin in moist young curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited milk lipase and starter esterase lipolysis yields low butanoic and hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: 31.3% fat emulsion lubricates mouthfeel despite acid-crumbly casein network.

crumbliness.reason: Low pH demineralizes colloidal calcium phosphate and light pressing gives friable acid-curd fracture.

firmness.reason: 41.8% moisture lightly pressed rennet gel gives semi-firm but not hard-grana body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol in short age.

fruity.reason: Brief aging limits esterase esterification of fatty acids to ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goat branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Short age limits leucine-isoleucine Strecker to 2-methylbutanal and 3-methylbutanal and pyrazines.

melt.reason: pH near 5.0 partly demineralized para-casein flows moderately on heating without fibrous stretch.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Geotrichum or Penicillium camemberti so no linoleic oxidation to 1-octen-3-ol.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat in young intact protein network entraps fat with limited free-oil release.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make with no wood-smoke phenols such as guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Homofermentative Lactococcus starter converts lactose to L-lactic acid to pH 4.6-5.2 with little acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Rennet-gelled non-kneaded curd lacks aligned pasta-filata para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No high curd cook and low starter methionine catabolism to methanethiol and dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Most lactose drained and fermented leaving only residual galactose and lactate sweetness.

umami.reason: Short rennet-plasmin proteolysis yields low free glutamate and savory peptides.
